p.text: How does Kamola feel about the village now?

fb.correct: "I didn't use to like the village, but now I feel nostalgia."
fb.incorrect_default: "I didn't use to like the village, but now I feel nostalgia."

1.say: Is this you? You look about eight years old. That photograph is from 2009. I used to live in a village then. Did you use to walk to school? Every day. It took forty minutes. My classmates walked with me. And that school behind you? That was my school. They closed it three years ago. So you have not been there since 2022. No. My grandparents moved to the city before that. Do you miss it? Sometimes. I didn't use to like the village, but now I feel nostalgia.

grammar.label: used to / didn't use to
grammar.form: used to + base verb; didn't use to + base verb; Did you use to…?
grammar.meaning: a past habit or state that is no longer true

explanation.en: Use 'used to' for something that was true before but is not true now. In questions and negatives it is 'use to', with no d.
explanation.uz: Ilgari to'g'ri bo'lgan, hozir esa to'g'ri bo'lmagan ish uchun. Savol va inkorda 'd' YOZILMAYDI: 'didn't use to'.

grammar.positive_example: I used to live in a village.
grammar.negative_example: I didn't used to live in a village.

l1_notes.uz: 'used to + fe'l' (ilgari qilardim) va 'be used to + -ing' (odatlangan) butunlay boshqa — ikkinchisi B1 da.

grammar.label: ago vs before
grammar.form: period + ago; before + a point or clause
grammar.meaning: counting back from now vs earlier than something

explanation.en: 'ago' counts back from now and comes AFTER the period: 'two days ago'.
explanation.uz: 'ago' hozirdan orqaga sanaydi va davrdan KEYIN keladi: 'two days ago'.

grammar.positive_example: I saw him two days ago.
grammar.negative_example: I saw him before two days.

l1_notes.uz: O'zbekcha 'ikki kun oldin' — so'z tartibi teskari.

grammar.label: for vs since
grammar.form: for + a period; since + a point in time

explanation.en: for + two hours, three years, a long time. since + Monday, 2019, I was a child.
explanation.uz: for + ikki soat, uch yil. since + dushanba, 2019-yil, bolaligimdan.

l1_notes.uz: Ruscha 'уже три года' → 'for three years', 'since three years' EMAS.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: Is this you? You look about eight years old.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: That photograph is from 2009. I used to live in a village then.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: Did you use to walk to school?

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Every day. It took forty minutes. My classmates walked with me.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: That was my school. They closed it three years ago.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: So you have not been there since 2022.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: No. My grandparents moved to the city before that.

body.speaker: Kamola
body.text: Sometimes. I didn't use to like the village, but now I feel nostalgia.
